sources: https://www.mwcd.org/places/tappan-lake/ (read in a browser; Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP)

hookups.source: https://www.mwcd.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/camp_rate_brochure_for_web-1.pdf ('Premium lots are renovated sites with 50 amp electric, full hook-up concrete pads', priced for Tappan) + https://www.mwcd.org/places/tappan-lake/ ('full hook-up, electric and primitive sites'; 'If you choose an electric campsite, 30-amp service is provided'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: MWCD says '500+' across Camp Areas 1-5 and Cabin Hill. A limited number are seasonal; the transient count isn't published.

sites.source: https://www.mwcd.org/places/tappan-lake/ ('500+ campsites (full hook-up, electric and primitive sites)'; 'More than 500 campsites are available for RVs and tents'), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.mwcd.org/places/tappan-lake/ ('Shower house & laundry facilities', 'Camp store', 'Dump stations & weekly services'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: MWCD's own reservation site or the call center, 1-855-822-6764; book at least 48 hours ahead (a Friday night by Wednesday). Changes and cancellations through the park office. Campers without a reservation are given the list of open lots.

booking.source: https://www.mwcd.org/visit-our-lakes/lodging-facilities/reservations-and-fees/ ('All reservations must be made 48 hours prior'; 'available both online and through the call center 340 days prior') + https://www.mwcd.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/2026-Campground-Rues-FINAL_.pdf ('except for seasonal camping and sites designated as non-reservable'; 'Campers without reservations will be provided with a list of available lots'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Active-duty military 25% off daily camping (subject to availability, free park admission); veterans 10%; seniors 60+ 10%; former POWs and 100% disabled veterans 50% off daily and 30-day camping. Discounts cannot be combined and apply only to the senior or veteran staying on the site.

note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District park on Tappan Lake off US 250 near Deersville. Only the head of Camp Area 1 looks at the lake, across the park road and the docks; the other areas lie in wooded valleys inland. Beach, marina. --Claude
summary: Hookups 50/W/S, 500+ sites, showers/laundry/store/dump, operator booking 340-day window and 48-hour cutoff, some non-reservable, military discount detail confirmed. Stored fees (manual) untouched: engine behind a captcha. Note trimmed. Season not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview is the most it can be, and it applies to the head of Area 1 only. MWCD's Area 1 map and imagery put the top row by 'Tappan Lake' ~50-100 m from the docked cove with the park road and boat storage strip between; Areas 2-5 are in valleys up to ~1 km inland, Area 2 behind a wooded ridge. MWCD's 2024 rate sheet lists no waterfront class at Tappan (unlike Seneca, Atwood, Charles Mill). No site is on the shore. No change proposed.

Pin 40.3212,-81.1860 is in the trees on the slope just north of the Area 1 road, ~90 m from the sites. Area 1 centre ~40.3207,-81.1855 from imagery: under the 250 m threshold, offered only as a tidy-up.
UNVERIFIED (captcha): reserve.mwcd.org refuses plain HTTP (405) and answers AWS WAF in a browser; not solved. Per-site rates, lengths, seasonal share and season not read.

FEES (manual provenance, not overwritten): stored $22-63 from AWH's saved July 2027 calendar; the $22 electric is well below MWCD's 2024 sheet ('Electric $46', 'Full hook-up $53', 'Premium full hook-up $64', 'Primitive $42', +$10 peak weekends/holidays) and below AWH's readings at other MWCD parks. It may be a real demand price; can't be checked past the captcha. mwcd.org adds 'There is an $8.00 per site non-refundable reservation fee' (suggest fees.reservation_fee 8).
Local park: the public can book an ordinary night. Phone 740-922-3649 confirmed. Rental RVs on site. Fox Trail has a closure map (2025), a trail matter only.
